messages:
maya: Heads-up: noticed negative cache credits showing in the amortization export for a few multi-model chains. small magnitude but unexpected. sample from logs: `cache_credit: -0.9` on tenant `acme-prod` after rollout.
oliver: can you paste the anonymized row or a snippet of the proto? chain id + token counts help.
maya: sure, copied an obfuscated row:
```
chain_id: chain-9a
models: [micro-v1, medium-v3]
req_tokens: 35
resp_tokens: 120
cached_prefix: 28
raw_cost_usd: 0.0096
computed_cache_credit: -0.9
```
@ sasha do we have past discussions about model-switches breaking amortization math?
sasha: we amortize prefetch savings by proportional token share but denominator is per-chunk effective cost which switches with model SKU. with non-linear per-token rates and rounding we can push allocated savings negative when a heavy-weight chunk follows a cheap one.
lia: also note we floor small per-request allocations to 3 decimals for UI. combined with tiny denominators that can flip the sign after rounding.
oliver: do we currently test cross-model chains in unit tests? i think coverage is only single-model chains.
maya: nope. i traced actual request where the session started on micro-v1 then after prompt expansion we routed the heavy generation to medium-v3.
deploy-bot: action: schedule canary for "amortization-clamp" at 02:15 UTC if PR lands.
sasha: mitigation strategy: clamp negative emitted credits to 0 in the console/invoice exports (retain raw value in internal tables). longer-term: compute amortization using an average effective-cost-per-token across the chain lifetime instead of per-chunk recalculation; add tests for variant-switch and several rounding modes.
lia: UI suggestion: expose a toggle in the cost dashboard: "Show raw amortization values" so SRE/finance can audit clamped differences.
oliver: sounds reasonable. can someone open the bug with repro rows and suggested hotfix + test? also we should reprocess only non-billed, display-facing rows for the last 24h to update what the console shows; do not change historical invoices without legal/product ok.
maya: filing the issue now with sample rows, query, and a small hotfix PR that clamps + logs. will link PR here.
sasha: i'll review asap. if small and safe, ship canary to staging and opt-in a couple tenants for observation.
lia: pinging @product-team for invoice policy — we need a decision on whether to adjust past external displays vs invoices.
maya: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/amortization/+/1234 (hotfix branch: clamp-and-log). canary results will be added.
oliver: thanks all. nice catch and clear plan.
_meta: auto-generated slack thread about unexpected negative cache amortization values
